title: Python requirement pinned with a wildcard
description: requirements.txt declares an `==N.*` wildcard pin, which accepts every release in that segment. The wildcard looks like a pin but accepts unreviewed patch releases, so two builds can install different code from the same file.
remediation: Pin the exact version and let the lockfile record the resolved release.
limitation: It matches an `==N.*` wildcard pin, which accepts every release in that segment in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
